blocks.arabic_text: التَّحِيَّاتُ لِلّٰهِ، الصَّلَوَاتُ، الطَّيِّبَاتُ الْمُبَارَكَاتُ لِلّٰهِ

blocks.text: Hadhrat Abdur Rahmaan bin Abd Qaari narrates that he heard Hadhrat Umar bin Khattaab (RA) teaching the Tashahhud to the people from the pulpit. He was telling the people to recite.... (التَّحِيَّاتُ لِلّٰهِ) The narration still continues further. [^1]
blocks.narrator: Hadhrat Abdur Rahmaan bin Abd Qaari

blocks.text: Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Abbaas (RA) says, "Rasulullaah ﷺ used to teach us the Tashahhud just as he taught us a Surah of the Qur'aan." [^2]

Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Mas'ood (RA) said, "Rasulullaah ﷺ taught me the Tashahhud with my hand in his just as he would teach me a Surah of the Qur'aan." The narration then proceeds to cite the words of the Tashahhud. [^3]

Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Mas'ood (RA) also mentioned, "Rasulullaah ﷺ used to teach us the beginnings of the Surahs and the Qur'aan, as well as the Khutbahs for salaah and for other occasions (such as the Khutbah for marriage)." The narration then continues to discuss the Tashahhud. [^4]

Hadhrat Aswad reports, "Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Mas'ood (RA) used to teach us the Tashahhud just as he would teach us a Surah of the Qur'aan. In fact, he would even correct the simple errors we made in the Alif (ا) and Waaw (و)." [^5]
Hadhrat Hudhayfah (RA) Teaches Salaah to a man who Could not Perform Salaah Well

Hadhrat Zaid bin Wahab reports that when Hadhrat Hudhayfah (RA) once entered the Masjid, he noticed a man who was performing salaah without carrying out the Ruku and Sajdah properly. When the man had completed, Hadhrat Hudhayfah (RA) said to him, "For how long have you been performing salaah like this?" When the man informed him that he had been performing salaah in that manner for the past forty years, Hadhrat Hudhayfah (RA) remarked, "You have performed no salaah for the last forty years. Had you died while performing salaah in this manner, you would not have died on the creed in which Allaah created Muhammad ﷺ." As Hadhrat Hudhayfah (RA) then proceeded to teach the man how to perform salaah properly, he said, "Even though a man makes his salaah brief, he must carry out the Ruku and Sajdah properly." [^6]
